title.narrative: Media and Information Literacy (MIL) Awareness and Advocacy in Afghanistan

description.narrative:
Introduction: The awareness and advocacy workplan for Media and Information Literacy (MIL) in Afghanistan aims to address the urgent need for enhancing MIL skills among various media organizations, journalists, and media professionals in Afghanistan. By fostering awareness and advocating for the importance of MIL, this workplan intends to empower journalists to critically evaluate media content, understand MIL principles, and contribute to the development of an informed society. It will specifically target journalists, including women, journalism students, and media managers and professionals with tailored interventions to meet their specific needs and challenges.
Objectives: 1. Increase knowledge and understanding: This objective focuses on raising awareness and knowledge levels regarding MIL among media organizations in Afghanistan. It aims to ensure that journalists and media professionals have a solid understanding of MIL principles and how to apply them effectively in their work. 2. Equip journalists with necessary skills: This objective emphasizes the practical aspect of MIL by providing journalists and media professionals with the essential skills required to critically analyze media content, and understand MIL principles. 3. 4. Enhance Content Development: This objective focuses on producing accurate and reliable information. By addressing critical social issues, it aims to inform, engage, and empower Afghan citizens while promoting Media and Information Literacy principles to foster a more informed and critically engaged society. 4. Empower journalists to engage with media and information in a responsible and informed manner: This objective seeks to empower journalists, journalism students, and media managers to engage with media and information responsibly, ensuring that they are equipped to navigate the media landscape effectively and contribute to a more informed society. Special attention will be given to including women and youth in these empowerment efforts.
Key Activities: Baseline Assessment Development of Training Materials Capacity Building Sessions Contents Development Public Awareness Campaigns Monitoring and Evaluation
Deliverables: Progress report Final report By executing these activities, the workplan aims to increase knowledge and understanding, equip journalists with necessary skills, and empower them to engage with media and information responsibly, ultimately contributing to a more informed society in Afghanistan.
